videos.title: Arcadia1983 - SUNCITY
videos.evidence: Channel identity, not title text: the archived RoaR.gg website (data/raw-web/roar/roaresports-home-20180319.html and roargg-teams-roar-cs.html, captured Mar 2018) links its official YouTube button to this exact channel id, youtube.com/channel/UCWgh8qncxsumCICveaZNAOA; the channel shows Joined Oct 15, 2017, two days after the RoaR Gaming Community Steam group was founded (Oct 13, 2017). The channel was later renamed Arcadia1983 and this is its only remaining upload, dated inside the RoaR era.

videos.title: Ban Request: Oye and NoxV' Fukushima
videos.evidence: Title text: "Ban Request: Oye and NoxV' Fukushima" - the "NoxV '" prefix is the Nox Viator member tag format documented in the Steam group roster (e.g. "NoxV ' DaviD"), and the June 2014 upload falls inside the Nox Viator era (Oct 2013 - 2017). Fukushima is not in the archived rosters, so this is a tag sighting, not a confirmed member.

videos.evidence: Title text: "NOSY BULLETS vs ROAR GAMING" - names the era name RoaR Gaming, cast Oct 2018 inside the era, in an ESEA league. Corroboration: the same caster channel covers cArpegamer, whom the community's own Steam post names as RoaR.cs's ESEA opponent ("RoaR.cs loses 16-13 against cArpegamer in an EPIC Match 12!", Mar 1, 2018).
